newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistan money rates up despite funds inflow.
newsitem.headline: Pakistan money rates up despite funds inflow.

text.p: Pakistan's money rates remained pegged at higher levels on Tuesday despite an inflow of about three billion rupees on maturity of paper sold in an open market operation, dealers said.
Onvernight funds were offered at 20 percent at the opening but actual trade was conducted at 22 percent to 23 percent, one dealer said.

Heavy amounts were discounted as the market closed short and rates were likely to open at similar levels on Wednesday when the State (central) Bank of Pakistan will be in the market for its weekly open market operation. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
